image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a brown butterfly resting on dry grass. The butterfly has its wings spread open, revealing a dark brown dorsal surface with distinct orange-ringed eyespots (ocelli) on both forewings and hindwings. The body is fuzzy and brown, and the antennae are visible with clubbed tips. The background consists of out-of-focus dry vegetation.
